card.name: Odd characters inside foreign-script words
card.fires_on: A single unusual letter or character inside a transliterated or non-Latin word, such as ñ, ɣ, ī, 舍, or Lao and Gurmukhi characters. It appears in etymology or Buddhist-term passages.

modes.label: Sanskrit transliteration
modes.description: Accented Latin letters inside romanized Sanskrit or Indo-European terms.

modes.label: Non-Latin script
modes.description: A character inside a Lao, Gurmukhi or Chinese word.
